empty.title: Your story starts here
empty.body: Finish a step or a focus session and your stats will start to grow here.

focus.title: Focus time

steps.title: Steps and quests finished
steps.empty: Each step you finish adds to this chart.

best_time.title: Best time of day
best_time.summary: You tend to focus best in the {{part}}.

distractions.summary: They tend to show up in the {{part}}, most often on {{weekday}}. Good to know, nothing to fix.
distractions.empty: No distractions noted {{range}}. When you tap "I got distracted", you'll see when they tend to happen.

estimates.title: Guess and real time
estimates.ratio: Things usually take you about {{ratio}} times your guess.
estimates.ratio_close: Your guesses are usually close to the real time. Nice.
estimates.ratio_none: After three quests with a guess and some focus time, you'll see how your guesses compare.
estimates.empty: Finish a quest with a time guess to compare it with the real time.

xp.title: XP over time
xp.empty: XP from every step and quest will draw a line here.

recap.title: Your week in a glance
recap.estimates: Your time guesses got closer to the real thing
recap.cheer: Every one of these counts. Here's to a gentle new week.
